policy.fetch_method: git init; git remote add origin <url>; git fetch --depth 1 origin <revision>; git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
policy.checkout_location: upstreams/<name> (gitignored; clones and their working trees stay local, only this manifest tracks the pins)
policy.verified_with: git rev-parse HEAD after checkout; license files read from the checkout

upstreams.name: reap
upstreams.role: REAP observation and pruning plumbing; extension seam for HOPE (per contract: extend observation/plumbing, no independent pruning framework)

upstreams.name: strix-llama.cpp
upstreams.role: Strix Halo (gfx1151) runtime target: ROCm/HIP and Vulkan backends, MiMo (LLM_ARCH_MIMO2) architecture support with MTP and SWA

upstreams.name: rocmfp4
upstreams.role: ROCmFP4 quantization format: Q4_0_ROCMFP4 (4.50 bpw, dual UE4M3 scales per 32 weights) and Q4_0_ROCMFP4_FAST (4.25 bpw, single scale); patch/build/regression scripts

upstreams.name: llama.cpp
upstreams.resolution_method: merge-base of pinned halo-box/strix-llama.cpp revision 8c1c282ecb194e8f02613defcc4a07c22b6d1c08 against ggml-org/llama.cpp master via the GitHub compare API (fork point of the strix tree); commit verified (GPG) upstream
